description: This is a React component for a Next.js page allowing users to upload documents (Resume, Performance Review, Job Description), initiate a backend process to generate a professional persona via an orchestration workflow, and display progress. It includes functions for uploading files, polling status, and navigating upon completion.

methods.name: getBackendBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the backend base URL from environment variable or default localhost.

methods.name: assertOk
methods.description: Checks if a fetch Response is OK; throws an error with details if not.

methods.name: DocumentUploadPage
methods.description: Main React component for the document upload and AI persona generation page.

methods.name: pollBuildStatus
methods.description: Polls backend for build status until completion or timeout, updating progress indicators.

methods.name: uploadCategorizedDocuments
methods.description: Uploads the three categorized files to the backend for processing.

methods.name: handleGenerate
methods.description: Handles orchestrating the upload, workflow initiation, polling status, and navigation upon success.
